title: weivel plugin manifest
description: What a plugin declares to the weivel core: its name, the API it needs, its entry, what it provides and consumes, its permissions and the plugins it needs beside it. Every object stays open, so a field this schema does not name validates and is ignored.

importName.description: The name other plugins import this plugin by, and the namespace of the services it registers. Its identity as a repository is supplied from outside the manifest.

api.description: The lowest API major version this plugin needs. A floor, not a build tag.

entry.description: The built module a host loads, relative to the plugin's directory. Required once capabilities are provided.

targets.description: The applications this plugin is for, opaque to the core. Absent means every application.

capabilities.description: The host-facing contract: the abilities this plugin provides at activation, and the ones it asks to see the implementations of.

provides.description: Capability ids this plugin provides at activation.

consumes.description: Capability ids this plugin asks to see the verified implementations of.

services.description: The inter-plugin contract: what this plugin offers other plugins, and what it asks of them.

provides.description: Service ids this plugin registers, each namespaced by its own importName as <importName>:<name>, or a bare id the host lists as well-known.

anyOf.description: One service this plugin registers, with what it advertises.

id.description: The service id this plugin registers.

attributes.description: What this service claims, keyed by attribute name, until the live service reports its own.

additionalProperties.description: One advertised value, in the units its attribute name names.

consumes.description: Service ids this plugin asks for. A bare string asks for it optionally.

anyOf.description: One service this plugin asks for, and what its absence or its shortfall costs.

id.description: The service id this plugin asks for.

provider.description: The repository identity of the plugin this plugin takes the service from. Absent means any provider of the service id.

optional.description: Whether this plugin still starts when nothing provides the service. Absent means true, which is what a bare string means.

degradable.description: Whether this plugin accepts a service that never satisfies its constraints once the budget is spent. Absent means false, and it never excuses an absence.

constraints.description: What this plugin needs of the service, keyed by constraint name, compared against what the service advertises.

additionalProperties.description: One required value, in the units its constraint name names.

permissions.description: Declared permissions, opaque to the core, which keeps them for the host to show.

dependencies.description: The plugins this plugin needs installed beside it, each named by the import name it is imported by and located by a repository id or an owner/name.

items.description: One plugin this plugin needs, named by exactly one of id or name.

importName.description: The name this plugin imports the dependency by.

id.description: The repository identity of the dependency, which survives a rename.

name.description: The owner and name of the dependency's repository, for a repository whose id is not known. A name can be taken by someone else, so a host warns about it.

commit.description: The commit the dependency is pinned to.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest the dependency's artifact must match.
